answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Endorsed mill packer sack file with mill packers standing — 4-year training, 471 supervised packings, mechanical exam, guild dues. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 110 POA and 18 minutes each, 82940 POA and 13572 minutes in all. The spiral is what the farm must obtain, the lantern is what the farm must spend, and the shale is what the farm must wait for. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
